acceptance.given: The validator completes successfully and the receipt is generated from an isolated fixture that removes the content-identity and validator-version fields while all other inputs remain unchanged.

oracle.expected: The successful receipt contains trusted content identity and descriptive validator version, and the isolated mutation exposes the missing provenance fields.
forbidden: A successful receipt omits trusted content identity.
A successful receipt omits the descriptive validator version.
The provenance fixture changes any input other than the two named fields.

acceptance.then: The validator execution and receipt production have completed.
acceptance.when: Run the validator success path and isolated provenance mutation test.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the isolated receipt fixture with trusted content identity or validator version removed; the check must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure successful validation receipts persist trusted content identity and descriptive validator version and expose omission through an isolated mutation fixture.
slice_hint.state_transition: success receipt without provenance -> provenance-complete receipt; omission mutation -> failed verification.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Receipt has non-empty trusted content identity and descriptive validator version, and the isolated omission fixture independently fails.

Returning a successful result for the unsupported package.

acceptance.when: Execute the isolated unsupported-package verification fixture.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the unsupported-package fixture; any acceptance, emitted result, altered non-package input, or missing witness must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject unsupported packages deterministically and emit no validation result while preserving an independently recorded witness.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Unsupported-package rejection remains compatible with existing replay and validation receipt schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: unsupported package submitted -> rejection with no result and independent witness.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Isolated fixture exits with rejection, result payload is absent, and witness is independently present.

forbidden: Closure is accepted when the caller is omitted.
Changing inputs other than caller presence in the omission fixture.
Reducing the manifest to route reachability or omitted-caller checks without bidirectional reconciliation.
oracle.observable: Record the VDD closure verdict and generated Consumer Manifest; compare manifest entries in both directions with discovered VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing call sites.

acceptance.then: An isolated omission-fixture evaluation is requested for the VDD consumer.
acceptance.when: Run FR-9 consumer discovery and closure evaluation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the VDD omission fixture; closure must fail when caller presence is removed while the manifest remains bidirectionally complete.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require VDD consumer closure to reject omitted callers and enforce a complete bidirectional Consumer Manifest over VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Consumer manifest output remains compatible while closure validation gains omission and bidirectional completeness checks.

slice_hint.state_transition: caller present and reconciled -> closure pass; caller omitted or manifest asymmetric -> closure reject.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Omission fixture is rejected and every discovered VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing call has exactly one manifest entry with no orphan entries.
